$comment: Known answers for rental yield. Published worked examples found via web search on 2026-10-09 (direct fetch of the pages is blocked in the build environment). Gross yield = 12 months' rent ÷ property value; net yield = (rent actually collected − yearly costs) ÷ property value. Before income tax.

cases.name: ₹60 lakh flat, ₹2.4 lakh rent a year: 4% gross
cases.quote: a ₹60 lakh property with ₹2.4 lakh annual rent … 4%

cases.name: ₹50 lakh flat, ₹3 lakh rent, ₹50,000 expenses: 5% net
cases.quote: if the annual rent is Rs 3 lakh, expenses amount to Rs 50,000, and the property value is Rs 50 lakh, the net rental yield would be 5%

cases.name: ₹1 crore flat, ₹30,000 a month, ₹40,000 costs: 3.6% gross, 3.2% net
cases.quote: ₹1 crore … rent ₹30,000 a month … gross yield 3.6% … net yield 3.2%

cases.name: Pune ₹60 lakh 2-BHK, ₹20,000 a month, half a month empty, ₹30,000 costs
cases.quote: ₹60 lakh 2-BHK at ₹20,000 a month, with 0.5 months annual vacancy and Rs 30,000 annual society maintenance & property tax … net yield of 3.33%
